failures.trigger: executor dispatch is selected while authentication readiness is unavailable
failures.rootCause: executor installation or binary availability was treated as authentication readiness
failures.misleadingSignal: executor binary exists or version command succeeds
failures.correctSignal: explicit authenticated preflight succeeds immediately before dispatch
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs / EXECUTOR_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE
failures.guard: block executor dispatch unless explicit authentication readiness is true
failures.recovery: authenticate the selected executor or choose another authorized healthy executor, then rerun preflight
failures.completionRequirement: executor auth preflight is PASS and exact-head regression proof is CURRENT_VERIFIED

failures.trigger: a push is attempted without a successful local admission gate
failures.rootCause: remote CI was used to discover a locally detectable failure
failures.misleadingSignal: remote CI was used to discover a locally detectable failure
failures.correctSignal: local admission is PASS for the exact candidate before push
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: block push/certification until local admission passes
failures.recovery: run the local admission/certification flow, fix all findings, then push a new exact candidate
failures.completionRequirement: exact candidate has local admission PASS

failures.trigger: a PR is promoted from draft before required remote proof is current
failures.rootCause: PR state was treated as harmless metadata
failures.misleadingSignal: PR state was treated as harmless metadata
failures.correctSignal: draft remains active until the required proof stage is satisfied
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: keep PR draft until the lifecycle permits Ready
failures.recovery: restore draft or wait for current proof, then transition once and read back checks
failures.completionRequirement: Ready state is reached only after the required proof stage

failures.trigger: candidate HEAD changes after certification evidence was issued
failures.correctSignal: every dependent proof is bound to the current candidate SHA/tree
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: invalidate dependent proof on any candidate mutation
failures.recovery: return to preparation/review, recertify the new HEAD and rerun only invalidated proof
failures.completionRequirement: all accepted evidence binds the current candidate

failures.trigger: review findings are corrected while unresolved review threads remain
failures.rootCause: code fix was treated as equivalent to review-state reconciliation
failures.misleadingSignal: code fix was treated as equivalent to review-state reconciliation
failures.correctSignal: provider readback confirms zero unresolved blocking findings
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: block merge-ready while corrected findings remain unreconciled
failures.recovery: verify regression evidence, resolve applicable threads and read back provider state

failures.trigger: remote CI fails on formatting or diff-check errors that local admission should catch
failures.rootCause: remote failure was treated as normal discovery
failures.misleadingSignal: remote failure was treated as normal discovery
failures.correctSignal: trivial deterministic failures are eliminated locally before push
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: record the occurrence and require local admission for the next candidate
failures.recovery: run prepare, commit any deterministic fixes, then certify locally before push
failures.completionRequirement: format/diff failures do not first appear in remote CI

failures.trigger: worker execution starts without an executable dependency/toolchain environment
failures.rootCause: worktree creation was treated as execution readiness
failures.misleadingSignal: worktree creation was treated as execution readiness
failures.correctSignal: workspace bootstrap proves required toolchain and dependencies before worker execution
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: block worker dispatch until workspace execution preflight passes
failures.recovery: bootstrap the isolated workspace deterministically and rerun execution preflight

failures.trigger: backlog or orchestration projection contradicts main, claims, ChangeSets or live PR state
failures.rootCause: versioned projection was treated as live authority
failures.misleadingSignal: versioned projection was treated as live authority
failures.correctSignal: projection is recomputed or reconciled against canonical lifecycle evidence
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: block scheduling decisions that depend on unresolved projection drift
failures.recovery: recompute from main/claims/PR/evidence and reconcile the projection under a claimed ChangeSet

failures.trigger: a new push is attempted while known review findings from the same review batch remain unfixed
failures.rootCause: one-finding-at-a-time iteration was treated as efficient
failures.misleadingSignal: one-finding-at-a-time iteration was treated as efficient
failures.correctSignal: all known findings are dispositioned before the next candidate push
failures.detector: tooling/tdp-max/guard-evaluator.mjs + tooling/failure-learning/detectors.mjs
failures.guard: block avoidable partial-review pushes
failures.recovery: collect the full review batch, fix or explicitly reject every finding, then certify one candidate
failures.completionRequirement: no known review finding remains at candidate push
